test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which are the top performing states in NITI Aayog's SDG India index released in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala, Himachal Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Index for **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** evaluates the progress of states and Union Territories.
 
• It evaluates various parameters including health, education, gender, economic growth, institutions, climate change and the environment. 
 
• **Kerala** retained its rank at the top with a **score of 75.**
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** and **Tamil Nadu** both took the second spot with a score of **74**.
 
• Bihar, Jharkhand, and Assam were the worst performing states in this year’s India index.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The SDG India Index computes goal-wise scores on the **16 SDGs** for each State and Union Territory.
 
• These scores range from 0–100.
 
• If a State/UT achieves a score of 100, it signifies it has achieved the 2030 targets.
 
• The higher the score of a State/UT, the greater the distance to the target achieved.
 
• States and Union Territories are classified in four categories based on their SDG India Index score:
 
 
• **Aspirant (0–49)**
 
• **Performer (50–64)**
 
• **Front-Runner (65–99)**
 
• **Achiever (100)**
